purpose: Track God Mode objectives with explicit acceptance evidence, validation duties, blockers, and rollback paths.

goals.title: Expose God Mode module coverage in the dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard shows Dashboard, Goals, Repos, Docs, and Agents coverage cards.
Each card exposes the five required God Mode layers.
Coverage surface is backed by a shared contract event and a checker.
goals.rollbackPlan: Remove the module coverage panel, renderer, styles, event contract, and checker references as one reversible slice.

goals.title: Create a durable evidence ledger for active objectives
acceptanceCriteria: Every active objective has acceptance criteria.
Every active objective has validation commands.
Every active objective has rollback and evidence links.
goals.rollbackPlan: Remove the goals ledger contract, governance doc, package script, and checker from quality governance.

goals.title: Add repository health and publish-safety manifest
acceptanceCriteria: Repo lanes identify quality, security, docs, plugin, and rollback gates.
Publish readiness is not declared without CI-linked checks.
Plugin and agent readiness remain source-controlled.
goals.rollbackPlan: Remove the repo health manifest, doc, checker, and quality script reference.

goals.title: Create a living governance index for God Mode documentation
acceptanceCriteria: Architecture, quality, AI policy, module coverage, goals, repos, and agents docs are indexed.
Each indexed doc has an operating purpose.
Docs are connected to a checker instead of relying on manual memory.
goals.rollbackPlan: Remove the governance index contract, doc, checker, and quality script reference.

goals.title: Add agent lane status for safe autonomy and validation duties
acceptanceCriteria: Agent lanes declare skill path, autonomy boundary, and validation duty.
God Mode Developer lane is listed as an active checked lane.
Agent safety rules preserve least privilege and observable outcomes.
goals.rollbackPlan: Remove the agent lane status contract, doc, checker, and quality script reference.
